## Highlights

- Preserve successful module coverage when individual payload attempts fail or are blocked instead of incorrectly collapsing the target into `PARTIAL`.
- Use observed parser behavior to generate WAF-aware payloads while keeping SQL boolean and timing controls semantically matched.
- Confirm non-reflected DOM XSS directly in a browser with clean controls and multiple CSP-tolerant execution canaries.
- Reduce false-positive SSRF findings by rejecting payload reflection and requiring provider-specific metadata evidence.

## Traffic safety and performance

- Honor `429`, `Retry-After` and WAF challenge responses with a host-level wait-and-recovery circuit.
- Keep deliberate rate-limit verification `429` responses as evidence without parking unrelated modules behind the global WAF circuit.
- Pace backup archive enumeration per origin, prioritize high-yield paths and stop after pressure signals or a verified exposure.
- Reuse captured bodies across passive Sensitive Data, Secret Exposure, Script Source, Vulnerable Components and Known CVE analysis.
- Limit browser crawling to pages where JavaScript execution can add coverage, apply one shared hidden-parameter concurrency gate and batch only safe candidate prefilters.
- Exclude `robots.txt`, sitemap and `.well-known` discovery documents from active hidden-parameter probing.

## Accuracy and scan control

- Apply compound WAF encodings through one transformation path with exact URL-depth, UTF-8 and SQL keyword preservation.
- Generate encoded SQL time-delay/zero-control and boolean true/false pairs atomically.
- Continue discovery through nonstandard gateway statuses such as HTTP 556.
- Keep directory fuzzing and 403-bypass phases out of narrow `--mode` scans unless explicitly selected.
- Distinguish true browser-only DOM execution from browser-confirmed reflected XSS and reject pre-existing execution markers.

## Install with Go

The `engine/v0.2.8` module tag makes both commands install this release:

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.2.8
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@latest
```

## Downloads

- `akca-windows-amd64.exe` - Windows x64
- `akca-linux-amd64` - Linux x64
- `akca-linux-arm64` - Linux ARM64
- `akca-darwin-amd64` - macOS Intel
- `akca-darwin-arm64` - macOS Apple Silicon
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` - SHA-256 verification manifest

Release binaries include GitHub build-provenance attestations and can be verified with `gh attestation verify <binary> -R akha-security/akca`.

Browser-backed checks require Chrome, Chromium, or Edge. Use AKCA only against systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akha-security/akca/compare/v0.2.7...v0.2.8
